+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from _pytest.pathlib import module_name_from_path
+
+
+# groundwork: allow-duplicate batch wrapper over module_name_from_path deduplicating labels
+def module_inventory(
+    paths: Iterable[str | os.PathLike[str]], root: str | os.PathLike[str]
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Return the unique dotted module names for ``paths``, anchored on ``root``.
+
+    Names are computed with :func:`module_name_from_path` and returned in the
+    order they are first seen. The paths do not need to exist.
+    """
+    root_path = Path(root)
+    names = (module_name_from_path(Path(path), root_path) for path in paths)
+    return list(dict.fromkeys(names))

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from _pytest.module_inventory import module_inventory
+
+
+def test_empty() -> None:
+    assert module_inventory([], "/projects") == []
+
+
+def test_relative_to_root(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    paths = [
+        tmp_path / "src/tests/test_foo.py",
+        tmp_path / "src/pkg/__init__.py",
+        tmp_path / "__init__.py",
+        tmp_path / ".env.310/mod.py",
+    ]
+    assert module_inventory(paths, tmp_path) == [
+        "src.tests.test_foo",
+        "src.pkg",
+        "__init__",
+        "_env_310.mod",
+    ]
+
+
+def test_unique_in_first_seen_order(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    paths = [
+        tmp_path / "b.py",
+        tmp_path / "a.py",
+        tmp_path / "b.pyi",
+        tmp_path / "pkg/__init__.py",
+        tmp_path / "pkg.py",
+        tmp_path / "a.py",
+    ]
+    assert module_inventory(paths, tmp_path) == ["b", "a", "pkg"]
+
+
+def test_strings_and_generators(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    paths = (str(tmp_path / name) for name in ("x/y.py", "z.py"))
+    assert module_inventory(paths, str(tmp_path)) == ["x.y", "z"]
+
+
+def test_outside_root(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    root = tmp_path / "root"
+    outside = tmp_path / "other" / "mod.py"
+    expected = ".".join(p.replace(".", "_") for p in outside.with_suffix("").parts[1:])
+    assert module_inventory([outside], root) == [expected]
